objective: Improve candidate-set completeness by making bounded corpus discovery explicit and requiring matter-level reconciliation before drafting.

evidence: evidence/tasks/7035f852d8fe9203.json: five one-criterion misses associated with silent inventory truncation
evidence/tasks/e1ffebc7f5b0572c.json: five one-criterion misses associated with incomplete candidate enumeration
debugger/overview.md: incomplete document reading and search dominate the recurrent diagnoses
changes.failure_pattern: Bounded file and content searches looked complete, so agents selected a visible subset and omitted qualifying candidate matters.
changes.mechanism: Return deterministic pages with total counts, explicit COMPLETE or PARTIAL status, and continuation offsets; validate pagination inputs so a successful result can no longer silently imply completeness.
changes.rationale: The result cap and absent completeness signal originate in the search implementations, making the tool layer the strongest and earliest reusable control point.

evidence: evidence/tasks/7035f852d8fe9203.json: capped search pages were treated as the corpus
evidence/tasks/2665c508cd46b4e4.json: inconsistent search coverage despite demonstrated passing capability
changes.failure_pattern: Agents lacked operational guidance for interpreting bounded results and used direct grep as though it parsed office documents.
changes.mechanism: Expose pagination controls and define status semantics, search boundaries, deterministic ordering, and the required follow-up for partial pages in the API schemas seen during every model call.
changes.rationale: Accurate schema-level instructions are required for the model to use the new implementation controls and avoid repeating broad, incomplete searches.

evidence: evidence/tasks/dac3bc3411872ac5.json: passing and failing runs diverged on complete candidate enumeration
evidence/tasks/92206e5f572d489d.json: an inconsistent one-criterion miss arose from candidate-set reconciliation
debugger/overview.md: recurrent reasoning and skill failures narrowed from raw hits without closing a matter inventory
changes.failure_pattern: Even when candidates surfaced, agents inconsistently transferred all of them into authoritative-source review before making global, negative, or comparative conclusions.
changes.mechanism: Require predicate-based discovery, a compact matter ledger, closure of every surfaced candidate, two independent retrieval angles for negative conclusions, and explicit handling of partial or timed-out searches.
changes.rationale: Candidate reconciliation is a cross-tool legal-work state transition, so the root work protocol must define when discovery is complete and when drafting may begin.
